criterion: 僅受影響設計建立候選；基準一致可依授權更新，基準已改變時保留資料並指出差異；舊／新 SPEC 分別可解析其確認版本，歷史版本不被修改。
method: Source/contract review and actual executable host regressions
finding: Staged BASE records retain exact preparation bytes. Same-version competing bytes, removal changes and historical mismatch reject writes before effects; confirmed membership deltas preserve unrelated additions, while ordering conflicts explicitly reject and retain differences.
